meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把通道连接到智能体分组,管理隔离级别,新增通道分组
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要管理多个智能体分组,并需要控制它们之间的通道和隔离。
copy.tagline_en: Connect channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, and add channel groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple agent groups and need to control channel wiring and isolation.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能帮你把新聊天渠道(如 Telegram 群)接到对应的助手分组上,设定各对话是否共享上下文,以及触发方式;也能帮你查看当前所有渠道的连接状态,并修复曾经误配的 WhatsApp 群。
howto.when: 在添加新渠道之后、初次搭建时,或想调整现有渠道接线时,Claude 会接管这些配置步骤。若实例还没有管理员(owner),它会先提示你运行 /init-first-agent。

say.text: 把这个新 Telegram 群接到我的销售分组。
say.note: Claude 会询问隔离方式并完成接线。

say.text: 帮我看看目前有哪些渠道已经接好、还有哪些没接。
让 Slack 的 #support 只在被 @ 时才回复。
say.note: Claude 会修改该连接的触发模式。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you wire new channels (e.g. Telegram groups) to agent groups, choose if conversations share context, set trigger mode, list existing connections, and fix mis-wired WhatsApp groups.
howto.when_en: Triggered after adding a new channel, during initial setup, or when you want to reconfigure existing channel wiring. If no owner exists yet, Claude tells you to run /init-first-agent first.

say_en.text: Connect this new Telegram group to my sales group.
say_en.note: Claude will ask about isolation and wire it up.

say_en.text: Show which channels are connected and which aren't yet.
Make the Slack #support respond only when @-mentioned.
say_en.note: Claude updates that wiring's trigger mode.
